notes: Numbers spelled out above a hundred now survive the sentence. "Rotate it one hundred and eighty degrees" turned the clip 90 instead — Crisp read the "and" in the number as if you had asked for two separate things, kept the first half, and quietly used its default angle. "Trim it to one hundred and twenty seconds" and "between two and six seconds" broke the same way. Asking for two things at once still works exactly as before: "mute it and make it vertical" is still two edits.
